item.title: Check a changed train platform
item.summary: An announcement mixes a platform change with information about an onward bus.
item.transcript_text: Passengers for the two oh six train to Eastbridge, please listen. Your train will now leave from platform four. Platform two is closed for cleaning. Use the lift beside the bookshop if you have heavy bags. The Eastbridge train will run five minutes late. The last bus to Winton still leaves Eastbridge at two forty-six, so ask the conductor if you need help with that connection.

questions.explanation: The Eastbridge service is the one affected.
Platform four is the replacement platform.

questions.prompt: Why is platform two out of use?
questions.explanation: The announcement names cleaning as the reason.

questions.prompt: Who can help a traveller concerned about the bus?
questions.explanation: The last sentence directs travellers to the conductor.
Only the train runs five minutes late.

children.segment_text: will now leave from platform four
